properties.name: cams.demo-now
properties.description: Fixed ISO-8601 date and time with an offset for demo mode. Leave empty to use the system clock.

properties.name: cams.mail.enabled
properties.description: Send confirmation and reminder emails through SMTP. When false, the email is only logged as disabled.

properties.name: cams.mail.reminder-interval-ms
properties.description: Delay between automatic reminder runs, in milliseconds.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed frontend origins.
